questions.stem: What is the physiological function of Cortisol
questions.explanation:
(Stimulates protein degradation in muscle)** — cortisol: protein catabolism ที่ muscle → amino acid ไป hepatic gluconeogenesis; เพิ่ม lipolysis (permissive), ลด glucose uptake ที่ peripheral (ยกเว้นสมอง), ต้านการอักเสบ
Trap: cortisol เพิ่ม gluconeogenesis และ lipolysis

Trap: somatostatin ลด GH และ glucagon; IGF-1 ลด glucose

questions.stem: A man with type 1 diabetes takes insulin before meals. Which of the following is correct after taking insulin?

choices.A: PFK-2 phosphorylation: No · PFK-2 activity: High · F2,6BP: Increase · Muscle glucose uptake: Increase
choices.B: PFK-2 phosphorylation: No · PFK-2 activity: Low · F2,6BP: Decrease · Muscle glucose uptake: Increase
choices.C: PFK-2 phosphorylation: Yes · PFK-2 activity: High · F2,6BP: Increase · Muscle glucose uptake: Increase
choices.D: PFK-2 phosphorylation: No · PFK-2 activity: Low · F2,6BP: Decrease · Muscle glucose uptake: Decrease
choices.E: PFK-2 phosphorylation: Yes · PFK-2 activity: High · F2,6BP: Increase · Muscle glucose uptake: Decrease

(A: PFK-2 not phosphorylated, high activity, F2,6BP ↑, muscle glucose uptake ↑)** — insulin → protein phosphatase dephosphorylate PFK-2/FBPase-2 → kinase activity สูง → F2,6BP ↑ → glycolysis ↑ gluconeogenesis ↓; insulin → GLUT4 ที่ muscle
Trap: glucagon ทำตรงข้าม (PKA phosphorylate)

choices.A: Esterification of free cholesterol on HDL
choices.B: Exchange of HDL cholesteryl ester for VLDL triglyceride
choices.D: Uptake of HDL cholesterol by the liver
choices.E: Efflux of cholesterol from macrophages to apoA-I

questions.stem: A 45-year-old man came to the hospital for a medical check-up. Laboratory results showed increase plasma calcium level. The doctor prescribed thiazide diuretic. After 6 months, Which of the following sign/symptoms can be found in this man
questions.explanation:
(Slow reflex)** — hyperparathyroid/hypercalcemia + thiazide (เพิ่ม Ca reabsorption) → hypercalcemia แย่ลง → Ca²⁺ สูงทำให้ threshold ของ Na⁺ channel สูง → excitability ↓ → hyporeflexia, muscle weakness, constipation, polyuria
Trap: tetany และ seizure เป็นของ hypocalcemia
issues: bradycardia ก็พบได้ใน hypercalcemia (D)
